text: Proposition forty proposes a one-time tax on very
large fortunes.
The proposal reaches up to five percent of
covered net worth for certain billionaires tied to
California residency on January first, twenty twenty-six.
It is not simply five percent of the
amount above one billion dollars.
Ninety percent of revenue is directed to health
care;
the remainder supports education,
food assistance, and administration.
Props forty-one and forty-two could block this measure
if a conflicting measure passes with more yes
votes.
A voter might see concentrated wealth as a
source of funding for health care and other
needs without broadly raising taxes.
They may prefer recurring funding with fewer collection
uncertainties.
Yes adopts the proposed tax, subject to the
legal outcome; no rejects this one-time levy.
Visit our website for the fuller explanation,
source links, and official voter guide.
